related.title: CAN CC：仲裁匯流排負載與觀測幀長
related.titleEn: CAN CC: arbitration-bus load and observed frame length
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學每實例History容量32筆；0.2 s通過、0.5 s不足；多實例總資源與Reliability阻塞仍需另驗。 dds_history.csv、每實例佇列與狀態事件 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 20 與變更 50 samples/instance、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。 附離線證據實驗：python3 tools/curriculum-v28/labs-optical.py --lab comm-v28-205 --out ./comm-v28-205-evidence；輸出目錄必須尚不存在。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. TeachingHistory capacity32 per instance:0.2 s passes and0.5 s fails; aggregate multi-instance resources and Reliability blocking remain separate checks. dds_history.csv, per-instance queues and status events Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 20 and changed 50 samples/instance, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them. Offline evidence lab: python3 tools/curriculum-v28/labs-optical.py --lab comm-v28-205 --out ./comm-v28-205-evidence; the output directory must not already exist.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學此流占用預算0.08；100/s通過、300/s不足；仍需對低優先訊息做阻塞與高優先干擾分析。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching per-flow budget0.08:100/s passes and300/s fails; low-priority deadlines still require blocking and higher-priority interference analysis.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成100 samples/s，停頓0.2 s；擾動0.5 s，每實例獨立計算，時間窗含起點不含終點。 名義式 ceil(100*0.2) = 20 samples/instance；變更式 ceil(100*0.5) = 50 samples/instance。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 明列0、0.01直到小於0.2或0.5的時戳並計數；若端點規則改變，須重新處理可能的一筆邊界樣本。

合成每幀觀測150 bits、100 frames/s、500 kbit/s；訊息頻率增300/s，幀長不變。 名義式 150*100/500000 = 0.03 bus fraction；變更式 150*300/500000 = 0.09 bus fraction。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 先算每幀300 µs占用，再乘一秒內幀數；與時間軸忙碌區間聯集比較，避免重複計重疊。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic100 samples/s and pause0.2 s changed to0.5, counted per instance in a window including start and excluding end. Nominal ceil(100*0.2) = 20 samples/instance; changed ceil(100*0.5) = 50 samples/instance. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Enumerate timestamps0,0.01 up to but excluding0.2 or0.5; changed endpoint conventions require accounting for a possible boundary sample.

Synthetic observed150 bits per frame at100 frames/s on500 kbit/s; increase frequency to300/s with unchanged length. Nominal 150*100/500000 = 0.03 bus fraction; changed 150*300/500000 = 0.09 bus fraction. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: First derive300 microseconds per frame then multiply byone-second frame count; compare with the union of busy intervals to avoid double-counting overlaps.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.difference: 將TTL、回應來源、送收時間及探測識別碼關聯，標明RTT差只是觀測差。
related.differenceEn: Join TTL, reply source, send/receive times and probe ID; label RTT differences as observation differences only.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成100 samples/s，停頓0.2 s；擾動0.5 s，每實例獨立計算，時間窗含起點不含終點。 名義式 ceil(100*0.2) = 20 samples/instance；變更式 ceil(100*0.5) = 50 samples/instance。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 明列0、0.01直到小於0.2或0.5的時戳並計數；若端點規則改變，須重新處理可能的一筆邊界樣本。

Time Exceeded 暴露TTL耗盡的觀測；各跳回應可走不同回程，不能直接相減成單向鏈路延遲。
教學基準：18-10 = 8 ms；對照：24-10 = 14 ms。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic100 samples/s and pause0.2 s changed to0.5, counted per instance in a window including start and excluding end. Nominal ceil(100*0.2) = 20 samples/instance; changed ceil(100*0.5) = 50 samples/instance. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Enumerate timestamps0,0.01 up to but excluding0.2 or0.5; changed endpoint conventions require accounting for a possible boundary sample.

Time Exceeded exposes TTL expiry; replies may use different return paths, so hop RTT differences are not one-way link delays.
Teaching baseline: 18-10 = 8 ms; comparison: 24-10 = 14 ms. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
